teaser.en: A citrus-family tree whose three-part leaves smell of lemon when crushed, with wood hard enough to be called ironwood.
teaser.sw: Mti wa familia ya michungwa ambao majani yake ya sehemu tatu hunukia limau yakipondwa, na mbao zake ni ngumu kiasi cha kuitwa 'mti-chuma'.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa, ambao makodzage ga seemu tahu ganalavya arufu dza ya ndimu gachihopezwa, na nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu hata kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *ironwood*, 'muhi wa chuma'.

summary.en: Mkumba mbega is white ironwood, a coastal forest tree of the citrus family with aromatic three-part leaves and very hard wood.
summary.sw: Mkumba mbega ni *white ironwood*, mti wa misitu ya pwani wa familia ya michungwa wenye majani ya sehemu tatu yenye harufu nzuri na mbao ngumu sana.
summary.dg: *Mkumba mbega* ni *white ironwood*, muhi wa matsaka ga pwani wa jamii ya michungbwa, wenye makodza ga seemu tahu genye arufu nono, na nyama za muhi ngumu sana.

about.en:
*Mkumba mbega* is an evergreen tree, from a shrub up to about 20 metres. Its leaves are divided into three narrow leaflets with wavy edges, and they smell of citrus when crushed, as many plants in the citrus family do. Small greenish-white flowers grow in clusters at the ends of the branches, and the small round fruits ripen to purplish black.

The bark is pale grey and smooth, and the wood is pale, hard and heavy, which is where the English name white ironwood comes from.
about.sw:
*Mkumba mbega* ni mti usiopukutisha majani, kuanzia ukubwa wa kichaka hadi urefu wa takriban mita 20. Kila jani limegawanyika katika vijani vitatu vyembamba vyenye kingo za mawimbi, na yakipondwa hunukia kama michungwa, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingi ya familia ya michungwa. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe huota kwa vishada kwenye ncha za matawi, na matunda madogo ya mviringo huiva na kuwa ya zambarau iliyokolea hadi nyeusi.

Gome ni la kijivu hafifu na laini, na mbao zake ni nyeupe-nyeupe, ngumu na nzito; hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza *white ironwood* ('mti-chuma mweupe') lilipotoka.
about.dg:
*Mkumba mbega* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati; unaweza kukala chitsaka, au muhi wa ure wa hadi mita ishirini hivi. Chila kodza rinaganyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu membamba, genye kanda-kanda dza mambi, na gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu dza ya michungbwa, dza vira mimea minji ya jamii ya michungbwa inavyohenda. Maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru iriyo na chijani ganamera kpwa mabunda kpwenye ntsa za panda, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganaivwa na kukala ga rangi nyiru iriyo na zambarau.

Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na ni laini. Nyama za muhi ni za rangi ngushu-ngushu, ngumu na ndziho; ndiyo sababu kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *white ironwood*.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and dune bush and is found from East Africa south to South Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka vya kwenye matuta ya mchanga, na unapatikana kuanzia Afrika Mashariki kusini hadi Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na weruni wa mafungu ga mtsanga ga pwani, na unaphahikana kula Afrika Mashariki hadi Afrika Kusini.

uses.en: Elsewhere in its range the hard wood is used for tool handles, poles and implements, and the leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Katika maeneo mengine unakopatikana, mbao zake ngumu hutumika kutengeneza mipini ya zana, nguzo na vifaa mbalimbali, na majani na mizizi yake hutumika katika dawa za asili. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Phatu phanjina unaphophahikana, nyama ngumu za muhi uhu nkuhumirwa kuhenda miphini ya vifaa, maphungo na vifaa vyanjina, na makodza na miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia lists *mkumba mbega* among the names he could not analyse, so its meaning is unknown. No other language shares it. 'White ironwood' is the usual English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mkumba mbega* miongoni mwa majina ambayo hakuweza kuyachambua, kwa hiyo maana yake haijulikani. Hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii kwa kawaida huitwa *white ironwood*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkumba mbega* kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage, kpwa hivyo manage tagamanyikana. Takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. *White ironwood* ni dzina ra Chingereza ra kawaida ra aina ihi, ela Pakia kariandika.
